lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 101610103 · After Temporary Bunny Group chat 1. Rouge has invited {AccountData.NickName} to jo…

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How'd it go?
How'd what go?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The lottery!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Didn't you say you had good luck?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You bought a lottery ticket, didn't you?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Did you win the first prize?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Can we finally afford a fridge for my sodas?
I thought that's what the fridge in the Commander's Room was for.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: It is?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I guess you're right, my soda does take up about 90% of that fridge...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: But that's not important!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Don't change the subject.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I wanna know if you've won the lottery.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Did you hit the jackpot?
I never bought a ticket.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Aw, c'mon!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why were you so obsessed about having good luck then?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I was kinda jealous cause I thought you'd hit it big.
I'm going to take part in the event organized by Coin Rush.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: OMG!!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The one where the winner gets a smooch from Noir and Blanc?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: So THAT'S why you want lady luck on your side.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Pssh, figures.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I thought there'd be more to it than that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Well, good luck anyway.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Actually, you know...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'll be happy with second place.
I'll try.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: May fortune smile upon you... and me!
